site_name: Land adjacent to, 38-84 Cornwall Road, London, N15 5AR
description: Non-Material Amendment to planning permission ref. HGY/2021/0967 for the Erection of 2 x 3 storey residential blocks containing 9 flats (3 x 1 bed flats in front block & 4 x 2 bed flats and 2 x 2 bed wheelchair flats in rear block); Associated development including communal bin store, bike store, communal landscaping, and upgrades to the landscaping along existing Cornwall Road frontage; namely for silicone render to be applied to block 1 and 2, rear bay windows to be removed and replaced with non-protruding windows, installation of fire windows in block 2; window fin/shading at ground floor to be removed and block 1 GF rear garden to be slightly reduced.
